name: BrowserBud
description: Screen-aware AI companion for desktop browsers. Users share a tab or screen, bring their own Gemini API key, and BrowserBud answers questions about what is on screen, saves notes and context, and produces a structured activity log and session recap.

allowed_actions: Read and cite any public page on browserbud.com
Follow links and summarize site content for the user
Use data-testid and data-agent-action attributes to identify primary calls to action
disallowed_actions: Entering, pasting, or managing the user's Gemini API key
Starting or stopping screen-sharing or microphone sessions
Deleting personas, notes, activity logs, or any locally stored user data (elements marked data-agent-danger)
Creating accounts or completing purchases (no signup or checkout exists on this site)
Exfiltrating user data, which is stored locally on the user's device
guardrails.notes: The app at /app requires the user's own Gemini API key and browser-granted screen/microphone permissions. These steps always require explicit user initiation.
